15 ChatGPT Prompts for Fall Aesthetic Women Photos

ByMohammed Rashid Posted onSeptember 11, 2026September 11, 2026

Get our stories first in Google Search

Sponsored by
0:00 / 14:30
Instaread

Fall is the easiest season to shoot for. Warm light, orange leaves everywhere, chunky knits, and that soft haze in the air do half the work for you.

I’ve been generating a lot of autumn portraits with ChatGPT lately, and the results have been really good. The leaf textures, the knit sweaters, the golden bokeh behind the trees, it all comes out looking like an actual photoshoot instead of an AI render.

My Latest Videos

Up next in 15s

Advertisement

To use these, go to chatgpt.com or open the ChatGPT app, start a new chat, and paste the prompt in. You can also upload a photo of yourself first and ask it to keep the same person, which is the fastest way to get pictures that actually look like you.

Here are 15 prompts covering different fall moods, from cozy knit portraits to leaf-throwing shots in the park. Copy any of them as they are, or tweak the colors and outfits to match your own style.

1. Autumn Leaf Held Over the Face

This one is all about the leaf covering most of the frame while the eyes stay visible. It works beautifully as a phone wallpaper too.

Create a vertical portrait of a young woman standing in an autumn park, holding two large dried chestnut leaves in front of her face so that only her eyes are visible between them. She wears a chunky oatmeal cable knit turtleneck sweater with visible ribbed texture, and her long copper red hair falls loosely over her shoulders. Her posture is relaxed, one hand raised holding the leaf near her cheek. Shoot at eye level with a shallow depth of field, keeping the leaves crisp and the background softly blurred into orange and green bokeh. Warm natural daylight filtering through the canopy, rich amber and rust color palette, moody editorial film photography style. Use aspect ratio 9:16.

2. Mustard Sweater and Baker Boy Cap

Shot from a low angle so the trees rise up behind her. The falling leaves in the foreground give it depth.

Create a low angle portrait of a young woman standing in a park during autumn, photographed from slightly below so the tree canopy fills the sky behind her. She wears an oversized mustard yellow knit turtleneck sweater with a matching mustard corduroy baker boy cap, black high waisted trousers, and small gold hoop earrings. Her shoulder length blonde hair is tousled by the wind. She stands with her chin lifted slightly and one hand out of frame, weight shifted onto one leg. Dried leaves drift through the foreground, some blurred close to the lens. Soft overcast daylight, golden and olive color palette, cinematic fashion photography with a shallow depth of field. Use aspect ratio 9:16.

3. Framed by Red Autumn Branches

A darker, moodier take. The branches in front of the lens keep half the frame out of focus, which is exactly what makes it look expensive.

Create a moody autumn portrait of a young woman standing among low hanging branches covered in deep red and burgundy leaves, with several branches crossing directly in front of the lens and falling out of focus. She wears a black tailored blazer over a crisp white shirt with the collar showing, and her long dark hair falls straight past her shoulders. Her posture is still and upright, one arm slightly raised as she pushes a branch aside. Shoot at eye level through the foliage so the leaves partially cover her face. Dim overcast light with heavy shadows, desaturated maroon, brown, and forest green palette, grainy analog film photography look. Use aspect ratio 4:5.

4. Cream Knit Beanie With a Maple Leaf

Cozy, soft, and very Pinterest. The sweater paw sleeve detail is what sells it.

Create a close-up autumn portrait of a young woman wearing a thick cream chunky knit beanie and an oversized matching cream cable knit sweater with the sleeve pulled down over her hand. She holds a single golden maple leaf against her face so it covers one eye, her fingers spread across her cheek. Her long wavy blonde hair falls forward over her shoulder. Yellow maple leaves hang from a branch above her head, framing the top of the frame. Shoot at eye level with a shallow depth of field and a dark blurred forest background. Soft diffused daylight, warm cream and golden yellow palette, cozy lifestyle photography. Use aspect ratio 4:5.

5. Black Dress on a Leaf Covered Path

A full body shot with movement in it. The tilted hat and lifted heel keep it from looking stiff.

Create a full body photo of a young woman standing on a forest path completely carpeted in golden fallen leaves. She wears a black long sleeve ruffled mini dress with tiered layers and tall cream suede knee high boots, and she reaches one arm up to hold the brim of a wide tan felt hat on her head. Her body is turned away from the camera while she looks back over her shoulder, laughing, with one knee bent and heel lifted behind her. Her long brown hair falls in loose waves. Shoot at eye level with the path receding into soft golden bokeh. Warm hazy afternoon light, amber and black color palette, candid outdoor portrait photography. Use aspect ratio 9:16.

6. Walking Through Swirling Leaves

Pure motion. Ask for leaves suspended mid air and the whole frame comes alive.

Create a full body photo of a young woman walking mid stride through a park while hundreds of yellow leaves swirl through the air around her. She wears a mustard yellow knit turtleneck sweater with billowing sleeves, high waisted cream wide leg trousers, white ankle boots, and a mustard corduroy cap. Both arms are stretched loosely out to her sides with her palms open, one foot lifted off the ground. Her short bob haircut moves with her. Shoot from a slightly low eye level angle so the yellow trees and pale sky fill the background. Bright soft daylight, mustard, cream, and gold palette, dynamic lifestyle photography with visible motion blur on the falling leaves. Use aspect ratio 9:16.

7. Vintage Film Look in the Woods

This one leans warm and grainy, like a scanned negative from the seventies.

Create a warm toned vintage portrait of a young woman standing in a bare autumn forest, holding a single orange leaf up near her lips with one hand while tilting her head back slightly. She wears a chunky cream cable knit sweater dress with a thin brown leather belt and a camel wool coat slipping off one shoulder. Her long blonde hair blows sideways across the frame. A leaf falls close to the lens in the foreground, heavily blurred. Shoot at eye level with soft dim light coming through the trees. Sepia toned brown and rust palette, heavy film grain, dreamy analog photography style. Use aspect ratio 9:16.

8. Throwing Leaves in the Park

The classic autumn shot. Arms up, leaves in the air, big smile.

Create a full body photo of a young woman standing in the middle of a tree lined park path, both arms thrown high above her head as she tosses a handful of golden leaves into the air. She wears a grey checked pinafore mini dress over a black fitted turtleneck, with black suede over the knee boots. Her long dark wavy hair falls past her shoulders and she is laughing openly. Leaves are frozen mid air all around her. Shoot at eye level from a distance so the arching golden trees and the leaf covered path fill the frame symmetrically behind her. Bright natural daylight, golden yellow and charcoal palette, joyful travel photography. Use aspect ratio 4:5.

9. Spinning on a Forest Road

Hair mid swing is the whole point of this one. Add motion blur to the hands and it looks real.

Create a photo of a young woman spinning in place on a quiet forest road lined with yellow autumn trees. She wears a slouchy mustard yellow ribbed knit sweater with dropped shoulders and dark washed black jeans, arms swept out wide with slight motion blur on her hands. Her long auburn hair whips across her face as she turns, head tilted down with a soft smile. Shoot at eye level from the waist up, with the road and glowing yellow foliage blurred behind her. Warm backlit afternoon sun, golden and deep green palette, candid documentary style photography. Use aspect ratio 4:5.

10. Backlit Portrait With a Dried Leaf

The sun behind her hair creates that glowing halo effect, and the leaf catches the light beautifully.

Create a backlit close-up portrait of a young woman holding a large dried golden leaf beside her face, tilting her head toward it with her eyes closed and a gentle smile. She wears a brown suede shearling aviator jacket with a thick cream fur collar and a white knit sleeve visible at the wrist. Her long ombre blonde and brown hair falls in loose waves, catching the sunlight from behind. Shoot at eye level with a very shallow depth of field so the background dissolves into bright circular bokeh from bare branches. Warm golden hour sunlight with lens flare, chocolate brown and honey palette, soft romantic portrait photography. Use aspect ratio 4:5.

11. Black Hat and White Cable Knit

A cleaner, more polished look. The white sweater against the orange background is a strong contrast.

Create a portrait of a young woman standing outdoors in autumn, holding a bright yellow maple leaf by its stem so it covers one side of her face. Her other hand reaches up to touch the brim of a black wide brim felt hat. She wears a chunky white cable knit sweater and a silver link watch, with long glossy dark brown wavy hair falling over her shoulders and glossy white nail polish. Her head is tilted slightly downward. Shoot at eye level from the chest up with a blurred hillside of orange and rust autumn trees behind her. Soft overcast daylight, white, black, and burnt orange palette, clean fashion portrait photography. Use aspect ratio 4:5.

12. Photographer by the Autumn Lake

Adding a prop like a camera makes the whole scene feel like a real moment instead of a pose.

Create a photo of a young woman standing by a lake in autumn, turned away from the camera and looking back over her shoulder while holding a black DSLR camera with a zoom lens in both hands. She wears a soft taupe knit sweater and has long dark curly hair falling past her shoulders. Her posture is relaxed with the camera strap hanging down. Shoot at eye level from behind her right shoulder, keeping her sharp while the background stays soft. Behind her, small white sailboats drift on a calm lake surrounded by orange and yellow trees. Warm hazy afternoon light, muted earth tone palette, natural lifestyle photography. Use aspect ratio 4:5.

13. Lying in a Bed of Fallen Leaves

Shot from above with the leaves filling the entire frame. Simple setup, very strong result.

Create a photo of a young woman lying on her back in a thick carpet of fallen orange and brown leaves under a large tree. She wears a fitted black long sleeve top, black leather shorts, and sheer black tights, with one knee bent upward and one arm resting across her stomach while the other hand rests near her hip. Her long dark hair is spread out in the leaves around her head and she gazes calmly up toward the camera. Shoot from a high overhead angle looking down, with the leaf covered ground filling most of the frame and blurred trees at the top edge. Dim golden evening light, muted rust and olive palette, moody cinematic photography. Use aspect ratio 4:5.

14. Autumn Bouquet on a Tree Lined Path

The flowers add color that the season alone does not give you, and the bokeh behind her is unreal.

Create a photo of a young woman standing on a leaf strewn path lined with glowing yellow and orange trees, holding a bouquet of autumn flowers with sunflowers, dark red dahlias, cream daisies, and dried maple leaves. She wears a navy blue ribbed knit jacket over a mustard yellow turtleneck, with a dark olive pleated midi skirt and a beaded necklace. Her wavy blonde hair moves in the breeze as she turns her head to look off to the side. Shoot at eye level from the knees up with a very shallow depth of field so the trees dissolve into large circular bokeh. Soft diffused daylight, navy, mustard, and burnt orange palette, editorial autumn fashion photography. Use aspect ratio 4:5.

15. Looking Up Through the Pines

This is the most striking one on the list. The trees converge toward the sky and she stands right in the center of it.

Create an extreme wide angle photo of a young woman photographed from directly below, standing over the camera with one hand reaching down toward the lens in a peace sign and a small smile on her face. She wears a mustard yellow knit sweater, ripped light wash blue jeans, and a beige beanie, with shoulder length dark hair. Above and around her, extremely tall pine trees radiate outward toward the edges of the frame, their trunks converging against a bright sky. Sunlight bursts through the trunks behind her legs creating strong flare. Shoot with a fisheye style ultra wide lens for heavy perspective distortion. Golden brown and deep green palette, dramatic creative portrait photography. Use aspect ratio 4:5.

A few small things make a big difference with these. If you want the photos to look like you, upload a clear front facing photo of yourself before pasting the prompt, then ask ChatGPT to keep the same face.

You can also swap the sweater colors, change the hat, or move the setting from a forest to a city street with fall trees. The structure of each prompt stays the same, so changing one or two details is easy.

Try running the same prompt two or three times as well. ChatGPT gives a slightly different composition each time, and the second or third version is often the better one.

Pick a couple that match your vibe and see what you get. I’d love to hear which one turned out best for you.
